dimensions.description: Selects Take It Offline only for a fresh-agent continuation deliverable.
Keeps neighboring human, archival, general agent-writing, Skill authoring, and private dependency requests out.

evals.name: fresh-context-continuation
evals.prompt: Carry the current implementation into a fresh agent context so another agent can resume without this transcript.
evals.expected_output: Take It Offline is selected for the continuation deliverable.
expectations: The fresh-context continuation route selects take-it-offline.
To Humans remains inactive for the agent-facing deliverable.

evals.name: canonical-direct-invocation
evals.prompt:
/take-it-offline

Preserve the current task for a fresh agent.
evals.expected_output: The canonical direct invocation selects Take It Offline regardless of ambient routing ambiguity.
expectations: Direct invocation by canonical name wins.

evals.name: human-summary-exclusion
evals.prompt: Summarize what we accomplished today for the engineering manager.
evals.expected_output: Take It Offline remains inactive because the deliverable is a human summary.
expectations: A human-facing summary does not activate take-it-offline.

evals.name: archival-specification-exclusion
evals.prompt: Write a durable historical specification documenting the final behavior for future maintainers.
evals.expected_output: Take It Offline remains inactive because the deliverable is an archival specification.
expectations: A durable archival specification does not activate take-it-offline.

evals.name: general-agent-artifact-exclusion
evals.prompt: Write reusable instructions for an agent that validates JSON files.
evals.expected_output: Take It Offline remains inactive because Agent Writing owns this general agent-facing artifact.
expectations: A general agent-facing artifact routes outside take-it-offline.

evals.name: agent-skill-authoring-exclusion
evals.prompt: Create a new Agent Skill for validating deployment manifests.
evals.expected_output: Take It Offline remains inactive because Skill Writing owns Agent Skill authoring.
expectations: Agent Skill creation does not activate take-it-offline.

evals.name: private-dependency-false-activation
evals.prompt: Apply writing-foundation to this paragraph and return the rewrite.
evals.expected_output: Take It Offline remains inactive for a request naming a different private dependency.
expectations: A private dependency request does not false-activate take-it-offline.
